title: Sales Fresher: Skills You Need to Get Your First Job | TalentXcel Career Guide
description: A complete skills required for sales and business development freshers. Covers resume tips, interview questions, required skills, and how to land your first sales job.
intro: Starting your career in sales and business development is both exciting and challenging. This guide is specifically designed for freshers, graduates, and career beginners who want practical, actionable guidance — not generic advice.

bodySections.heading: What Recruiters Look for in Sales Freshers
bodySections.content: Most sales and business development employers hiring freshers look for foundational skills, learning ability, and a genuine interest in the domain — not years of experience. Demonstrating initiative through projects, internships, and certifications makes a significant difference.
bulletPoints: Relevant internships or academic projects in the field.
Core technical skills that match the job description.
A portfolio or GitHub/work samples demonstrating practical ability.

bodySections.heading: Essential Skills for Sales Fresher
bodySections.content: Before applying for your first sales and business development role, build proficiency in the core skills employers consistently require. Use TalentXcel Skills Assessment to earn verified credentials that make your profile stand out.

bodySections.heading: Your Career Path After Your First Role
bodySections.content: Most sales and business development freshers who build strong fundamentals and take initiative progress from entry-level to mid-level within 2–3 years. Focus on measurable impact, mentorship, and continuous upskilling.
bulletPoints: Entry Level (0–2 years): Skill building, project execution, mentorship.
Senior (4–7 years): Leadership, architecture, cross-team collaboration.
